run_instruction_following_oracle_agent: run the oracle agent CLI to navigate a StreetLearn environment using bearing-based navigation
run_goal_instruction_game: run the oracle agent with goal_instruction_game to navigate toward a single goal instruction
run_incremental_instruction_game: run the oracle agent with incremental_instruction_game to follow a sequence of waypoint instructions
run_step_by_step_instruction_game: run the oracle agent with step_by_step_instruction_game to follow step-by-step navigation instructions
run_with_stats_tracking: run the oracle agent with stats_path flag to log episode rewards to a file
